title: Ordinary restricted structure cycle class
statement: For any commutative ring A and open U of Spec A, let K=A[0] as a natural-index chain complex, L its integer extension, C its tilde complex [def-sc-koszul-open-system], and eta the termwise tilde.toOpen unit [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total]. Let j:H^0(L)≅A be the extension and single homology comparisons. Let e:T(C)≅O_U[0] be the ordinary extension-single, tilde-single, restriction-single and over-unit comparisons, for restriction T of [lem-sc-open-sections-cohomology-model-comparison]. Let epsilon:H^0(Gamma(U,O_U[0]))≅Gamma(U,O_U) be the single-map and single-homology comparison. Then H^0(Gamma(e inverse))(epsilon inverse(1)) equals openComparisonOrdinaryIso inverse applied to H^0(eta)(j inverse(1)). This is an ordinary homology equality and requires no derived categories, derived units, or quasi-coherence assumptions.

source.place: Tilde/sections adjunction unit and its restriction; ordinary cycle calculation in the proof of lem-sc-open-sections-structure-class, step 2.

proof.text: The fully proved private extension_single_homology identity identifies j with homology of extendSingleIso followed by singleObjHomologySelfIso. Cancel homologyπ and use homologyπ_extendHomologyIso_hom, homologyπ_naturality, extendCyclesIso_hom_iCycles, and extendSingleIso_hom_f. For an arbitrary map between complexes identified with single complexes, normalize its homology map to its degree-zero component using singleObjHomologySelfIso naturality. Apply this to the termwise tilde/sections unit, using the functors of def-sc-koszul-open-system and def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total.

Use naturality of ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for exact scalar forgetting. Its compatibility with single-complex homology follows by canceling homologyπ, the mapCyclesIso comparison, and singleMapHomologicalComplex in degree zero. This proves normalized_forget_comparison and applies to openComparisonOrdinaryIso of lem-sc-open-sections-cohomology-model-comparison. The global-sections class has normalized coordinate one, since homology of the inverse complex isomorphism cancels homology of the forward complex isomorphism.

The private ordinary_section_one calculation unfolds openComparisonSectionsIso on the unit sheaf: overFunctorEquiv and restrictAppIso act identically on the underlying section, transport of opens is a ring map and preserves one, and StructureSheaf.const_one identifies the tilde/sections unit on one. Naturality of openComparisonSectionsIso applies this calculation to the degree-zero inverse tilde-single map. All degree-zero single-map and over-unit comparisons are identities. tilde.toOpen_map_app for the inverse extended-single degree-zero component gives exactly the normalized ambient class. Apply the normalized coordinate equality and cancel the ordinary comparison and homology normalization isomorphisms. All steps are independent of nonemptiness and nonzero-ring assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem openComparison_ordinary_structure_class (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) :
    let T := openComparisonRestriction A U
    let K := (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)
    let L := K.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
    let C := ((koszulOpenTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L
    let η₀ : 𝟭 (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⟶ koszulOpenTilde A ⋙ affineOpenSections A U :=
      { app := fun M ↦ tilde.toOpen M U
        naturality := fun _ _ g ↦ (tilde.toOpen_map_app g U).symm }
    let η := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex η₀ (.up ℤ)).app L
    let j : L.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of A A :=
      K.extendHomologyIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (j := 0) rfl ≪≫
        HomologicalComplex.singleObjHomologySelfIso (.down ℕ) 0 (ModuleCat.of A A)
    let e₀ : L ≅ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A A) :=
      HomologicalComplex.extendSingleIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (ModuleCat.of A A) 0 0 rfl
    let e₁ : C ≅ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) :=
      ((koszulOpenTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso e₀ ≪≫
      (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (koszulOpenTilde A) (.up ℤ) 0).app
        (ModuleCat.of A A)
    let B := (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)
    let S := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
    let D := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
    let J := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
    let e : J ≅ D :=
      (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso e₁ ≪≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex T (.up ℤ) 0).app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ≪≫
        (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0).mapIso
            (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit U
              (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
    let ε : ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B :=
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex S (.up ℤ) 0).app _) ≪≫
        HomologicalComplex.singleObjHomologySelfIso (.up ℤ) 0 (ModuleCat.of B B)
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map e.inv) 0 (ε.inv (1 : B)) =
      (openComparisonOrdinaryIso A U C).inv
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap η 0) (j.inv (1 : A)))
